facts.text: The Euro NCAP virtual-testing protocol version 1.00 is dated March 2025.
The Euro NCAP virtual-testing protocol is an on-road consumer protocol.
facts.quote: It is an on-road consumer protocol

facts.text: No off-road body has adopted an equivalent of the Euro NCAP virtual-testing protocol.
facts.quote: no off-road body has adopted an equivalent.

facts.text: The Euro NCAP virtual-testing acceptance flow starts with an OEM simulation dossier containing vehicle, sensor, target and environment models.
facts.quote: OEM simulation dossier: vehicle, sensor, target and environment models

facts.text: In the Euro NCAP virtual-testing acceptance flow, the OEM simulation dossier undergoes in-house qualification using virtual versus physical tests, an ISO score and KPIs.
facts.quote: In-house qualification: virtual versus physical tests, ISO score and KPIs

facts.text: After in-house qualification, the Euro NCAP virtual-testing acceptance flow produces virtual predictions for the full scenario grid.
facts.quote: B --> C[Virtual predictions for the full scenario grid]

facts.text: Euro NCAP physically tests randomly selected cells from the scenario grid to verify virtual predictions.
facts.quote: Euro NCAP runs randomly selected grid cells physically

facts.text: Under the Euro NCAP virtual-testing acceptance flow, virtual results are accepted for a cluster if at least 75% of its verification tests pass.
facts.quote:
E{At least 75% of verification tests in the cluster pass?}
    E -- yes --> F[Virtual results accepted for that cluster]

facts.text: Under the Euro NCAP virtual-testing acceptance flow, failure to meet the 75% verification-test pass threshold causes rejection of the dossier for that cluster, requiring re-simulation or physical testing.
facts.quote: E -- no --> G[Dossier rejected for the cluster: re-simulate or test physically]
